what: City of Anaheim street centrelines (motorway, trunk, primary, secondary, tertiary, residential, unclassified, living street), clipped to the city boundary, with names and intersections.
attribution: Overture Maps Foundation (release 2026-09-23.1), derived from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0). City boundary: Overture divisions, from OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0).
units: decimetres; x east, z south (game coordinates); each geometry delta-coded, first point absolute
lanes: not available: Overture 2026-09-23.1 segments carry no lane counts

keys.seg: c class (dict.cls), n name (dict.name), r route, p points, k [vertex, connector index, ...], ow one-way (1 along p, -1 against), br bridge, tn tunnel, lv OSM level
